CA.rationale: The report lists the content (red coordinates) and attaches a processing/origin record to the same candidate referent.

COD.rationale: For the candidate referent the report provides identified content (coordinate sets), an organization/presentation (the coordinate listing as a pattern) and a separate origin/status field.

A.rationale: Processing/origin metadata (e.g. command_estimate, history_estimate) are explicitly attached to identified contents, linking processing state to content presentation/access.

C.rationale: The report explicitly lists identified contents (red/blue) and their coordinate attributes for multiple referents/times.

D.rationale: Contents are accompanied by separate status/origin fields (copied_prior_record, command_estimate, history_estimate) distinguishing identity from status/source.

O.rationale: The report states how contents are presented (grid orientation and explicit coordinate patterns for referents), indicating organization/presentation.
